name: Stalprodukt S.A.
summary: Stalprodukt S.A., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and exports highly processed steel products in Poland. It operates through three segments: Electrical Sheets, Profiles, and Zinc. The company offers electrical sheets and tapes; transformer cores; steel structures for photovoltaic farms; hydrogen; cold-formed steel sections and profiles; and steel road and bridge barriers. It also provides electrolytic zinc, zinc alloys, concentrates, and by-products of metallurgical processes. The company was formerly known as ZPH Stalprodukt S.A. and changed its name to Stalprodukt S.A. in 2005. Stalprodukt S.A. was founded in 1971 and is based in Bochnia, Poland.
